dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent network of irregular, light-colored 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters. The edges show a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity light gray/white perimeters to dark, low-intensity circular interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters located primarily along the upper dorsal ridge, appearing as singular points without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle; a secondary chain of four smaller annuli creates a curved linear trajectory towards the anterior region.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct reticulated pattern where multiple annuli appear to share common edges, creating a honeycomb-like structural arrangement across the mid-dorsal region.
